title: Visual feedback timing of 0.1 seconds
statement:
Visual feedback must occur within 0.1 seconds (100ms) for a user to perceive the system's response as instantaneous and directly tied to their physical action.

Options:
- Instantaneous Feel: < 100ms duration (fits: hover states, switch toggles, microinteractions)
- Flowing Transition: 200ms - 300ms duration (fits: modal entrances, menu expansions)
- Deliberate Pacing: > 500ms duration (fits: splash screens, success celebrations)
appliesWhen: Applies to: button states, hover effects, toggles. Audience: general.

source.title: Response time in man-computer conversational transactions
source.venue: Proceedings of the December 9-11, 1968, fall joint computer conference, part I (AFIPS '68)
